description.en: A split screen without any HTML: the form sits on white in the left half, the right half is your color with rings and a dot grid. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
The right half of the page, the button, links and focused fields.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 0 0% 100%;
  --foreground: 222 47% 11%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 222 47% 11%;
  --popover: 0 0% 100%;
  --popover-foreground: 222 47% 11%;
  --muted: 210 40% 96%;
  --muted-foreground: 215 16% 47%;
  --accent: 210 40% 96%;
  --accent-foreground: 222 47% 11%;
  --border: 214 32% 91%;
  --input: 214 32% 85%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: #ffffff;
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type,
.login-content,
#footer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.login-background::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 68%, transparent 0 90px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 90px 92px, transparent 92px 150px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 150px 152px, transparent 152px 220px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 220px 222px, transparent 222px 300px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 300px 302px, transparent 302px), radial-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) 1.5px, transparent 1.6px) 0 0 / 24px 24px, linear-gradient(150deg, color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 75%, #ffffff) 0%, {{accentColor}} 45%, color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 55%, #000000) 100%);
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type {
  width: 50%;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}
.login-content {
  justify-content: flex-start !important;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 400px;
  margin-left: max(0px, calc(25vw - 216px));
}
#footer {
  width: 50%;
}
.login-panel {
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-logo-box {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  background: #f1f5f9;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  color: {{accentColor}};
}
.login-form label {
  color: #334155;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 46px;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 18%, transparent);
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -8px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 70%, transparent);
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 88%, #000000);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
